free_tier.stated: Oracle Cloud Free Tier allows you to sign up for an Oracle Cloud account which provides a number of Always Free services and a Free Trial with US$300 of free credit to use on all eligible Oracle Cloud Infrastructure services for up to 30 days.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the offer is a spending balance, not a stored object

retention.stated: the credit ends at 30 days or when it is consumed, whichever comes first; the Always Free services continue after the credit ends

egress.terms: egress bills against the credit at list price; the Always Free allowance includes 10 TB a month of outbound transfer

interface_detail: the OCI console, the OCI CLI and every OCI API
tooling: the OCI CLI, Terraform provider, SDKs, and a WireGuard or OpenVPN endpoint on an Always Free VM
chaining: the trial credit buys 30 days of Ampere or GPU shapes that the Always Free allowance does not include; the separate oracle-cloud record carries the perpetual allowance

limits.value: USD 300 of credit for up to 30 days
16 OCPU and 96 GB of A1 per availability domain for a trial tenancy (service limit standard-a1-core-count and standard-a1-memory-count)

limits_note: the 16-OCPU figure is a per-availability-domain service limit, not a per-tenancy cap; a second AD is a second 16 OCPU, and A1 capacity is subject to availability

identity_cost.detail: a credit or debit card is required at signup, and Oracle states it does not accept debit cards with a PIN or virtual, single-use or prepaid cards; accurate contact and billing information is required, and there is one trial per person

reliability_note: the trial credit is consumed by a powered-on instance whether or not it runs work, and the separate Always Free allowance carries an idle reclaim test
confidence_note: the free-tier page was read on 2026-10-23 and states the amount, the 30-day window, the card rule and the Always Free continuation. No account was created

evidence.proved: quoted: 'a Free Trial with US$300 of free credit to use on all eligible Oracle Cloud Infrastructure services for up to 30 days'
quoted: 'Limits apply to each availability domain'; standard-a1-core-count is 16 and standard-a1-memory-count 96 GB for Pay As You Go or Trial
quoted: 'VM.Standard.A1.Flex | 76 OCPU | 1 GB or a value matching the number of OCPUs | 64 GB per OCPU, up to 472 GB total'
quoted: 'the first 1,500 OCPU hours and 9,000 GB hours per month ... equivalent to 2 OCPUs and 12 GB of memory'

notes: A1 bills at USD 0.01 per OCPU-hour plus USD 0.0015 per GB-hour; E4 at USD 0.025 and E5 at USD 0.03 per OCPU-hour. The trial service limit of 16 OCPU and 96 GB applies per availability domain, so the largest single A1 machine is 16/96 unless the limit is raised or a second AD is used. The trial page states the credit ends at 30 days or when consumed.

extras.reachable_by: a card that is not prepaid, virtual or single-use
extras.companion_record: oracle-cloud, the Always Free allowance with no end date

service_limit_a1.applies_to: pay as you go or trial

binding_note: the 30-day clock ends the balance before any usage ceiling is reached
